response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(amount) as avg_amount FROM trans), account_avgs AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) as avg_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT a.account_id, a.avg_amount, a.avg_amount - o.avg_amount as excess FROM account_avgs a CROSS JOIN overall_avg o WHERE a.avg_amount > o.avg_amount ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
